title: WakeTurbulenceSeparationRules
description: ICAO Doc 4444 PANS-ATM wake vortex separation standards for runway departures and radar approach.

HEAVY.description: Aircraft types of 136,000 kg (300,000 lbs) MTOW or more

MEDIUM.description: Aircraft types between 7,000 kg (15,500 lbs) and 136,000 kg MTOW

LIGHT.description: Aircraft types of 7,000 kg (15,500 lbs) MTOW or less
